# FLX-3605: a consumer query has a malformed or repeated id, or too many are declared

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A query's id is a lowercase letter followed by at most 127 lowercase letters, digits, '.', '-' and '_', and it names the query in the profile, the request and the scorecard, so it is unique across the queries. At most 1,024 queries are declared.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3605
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
